pr_title: INA237 Sensor Bug Fixes and Enhancements (with unit tests)
pr_body:
I have fixed several bugs in the INA237 and INA230 sensor drivers and also added unit tests to make sure the driver doesn't get broken in the future and/or make it easier to fix.

Fixes #60722

To run unit tests:
```sh
./scripts/twister -vv -p native_posix -T tests/drivers/sensor/ina237
./scripts/twister -vv -p native_posix -T tests/drivers/sensor/ina230
```
pr_comments:
I have updated the shunt voltage to have a reporting sensor value of mV to avoid loss of precision at low current levels since high-precision mode is 1.25 uV/bit.  This changes the val2 sensor value into nano-volts instead of micro-volts.

I have not rebased the changes so you can still do a compare.

Please have another look.  Once everything has been approved I can do a final rebase.

I have hopefully addressed all of the review comments and now added an INA230 unit test and fixes for issues found the INA237 driver.  Thanks for all of comments and your time spent reviewing the changes.
Finished with changes based upon review comments.  Next push will be a rebase.

```

issue_context.title: INA237 Sensor Driver Power Calculation Wrong
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
The INA237 power calculations are incorrect and show overflow issues and are 1000x too small.

Incorrect value seems to imply overflow in calculation since it doesn't follow the off-by-1000 issue seen later.
```
DEBUG   - OUTPUT: START - test_power
DEBUG   - OUTPUT: 
DEBUG   - OUTPUT:     Expectation failed at WEST_TOPDIR/zephyr/tests/drivers/sensor/ina237/src/ina237_test.c:137: test_power: (power_expected_W not within power_actual_W +/- 1e-6)
DEBUG   - OUTPUT: Expected 855.637965 C, got 0.426141 C
DEBUG   - OUTPUT: 
```

Off by a factor of 1000:
```
DEBUG   - OUTPUT:     Expectation failed at WEST_TOPDIR/zephyr/tests/drivers/sensor/ina237/src/ina237_test.c:137: test_power: (power_expected_W not within power_actual_W +/- 1e-6)

DEBUG   - OUTPUT:

DEBUG   - OUTPUT: Expected 0.051000 C, got 0.000051 C

DEBUG   - OUTPUT: Expected 0.005100 C, got 0.000005 C
DEBUG   - OUTPUT: 
DEBUG   - OUTPUT:     Expectation failed at WEST_TOPDIR/zephyr/tests/drivers/sensor/ina237/src/ina237_test.c:137: test_power: (power_expected_W not within power_actual_W +/- 1e-6)
DEBUG   - OUTPUT: Expected 0.000051 C, got 0.000000 C
DEBUG   - OUTPUT:  FAIL - test_power in 0.000 seconds
```
**To Reproduce**
I have written a new test case for this while I was debugging it and will upload this with the fix.

`./scripts/twister -vv -p native_posix -T tests/drivers/sensor/ina237`
